useCases: Sort points by X position for sequential animation effects
Randomize point order for organic particle emission
Sort primitives by proximity to camera for depth-based effects
Circular shift point order for looping animations
Sort by attribute for controlled rendering order
examples: Grid POP → Sort POP (By Attribute: P.x) → sequential noise offset
Particle POP → Sort POP (Random) → randomized trail colors

commonCombinations.description: Sort then assign color based on new order

troubleshooting: Sort not working: Ensure Attribute name exactly matches the attribute in your POP
Performance: Use Attrib is UInt optimization for integer attributes
Reverse + Shift: Reverse flips order, Shift offsets — combine for complex patterns
description: Sorts point and/or primitive lists based on position P or any attribute. Supports sorting by proximity to point, along vector, relative to Geometry COMP Z-axis, randomizing, or circular shifting. Uses FidelityFX Parallel Sort (GPU-accelerated).
